title: A closed work order's Shop supplies amount cannot be edited
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Shop supplies" shows $15.00 with no control to change it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S10-R2: “The amount can be changed on the work order until it is closed, with the existing per-work-order shop supplies control. Any customer change while the work order stays internal or no charge, or converting to no charge, resets it to the customer's Min. Making the work order billable again drops the flat amount and applies the customer's or the location's shop supplies rule as on any billable work order.”
  • S2-R9: “From Close or invoice on, the classification and the category are locked: a closed no-charge work order shows the No Charge badge with no Convert or Change category action, on a closed internal or no-charge work order the Change Customer button on the customer card is disabled with the tooltip "Reopen the work order to change the customer." (the lock an invoiced or paid billable work order has today, S2-R7), and the header card carries the line "Closed on [posting date]. To change it, reopen it from the Finance tab." There is no Reopen control on the work order itself (Story 4).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
